## About
Revmaster Machine & Parts is an automotive machine shop on Fairvilla Rd in Orlando. The work centers on Complete Engine Service and Cylinder Head Repair: boring, cylinder block honing, align boring, cam bearings and freeze plugs.
Customers bring in everything from heads off a Ford Mustang GT to a performance engine build to a single ATV head. One reviewer wrote that the machinist inspected every piston, ring and rod before the build went together.
We're rated 4.4 from 100 Google reviews. Call or email ahead and tell us what you're bringing in.

## Services
- Complete Engine Service: Full machine work on the engine, including boring, honing, align boring, cam bearings and freeze plugs.
- Cylinder Head Repair: Head work such as cleaning, resurfacing and valve stem seals. One reviewer had this done on Ford Mustang GT heads, and another had broken bolts removed from an ATV head.
- Boring: Cylinder boring for oversize pistons.
- Honing: Cylinder block honing to finish the cylinder walls.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I bring my own pistons and rods?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in his own pistons and rods for a build, and the machinist inspected them before assembly.

Q: Do you work on ATV and small engine heads?
A: One customer brought in an ATV head with a couple of broken bolts and wrote that the bike is back up and running.
